newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: CRICKET-PAKISTAN RECALL MUSHTAQ FOR SHARJAH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN RECALL MUSHTAQ FOR SHARJAH.

text.p: Pakistan recalled leg-spinner Mushtaq Ahmad in a 14-man squad named on Friday for this month's Sharjah tournament.
Mushtaq, who missed the home test series against Zimbabwe, returns after claiming 10 wickets in his first domestic championship match since knee surgery last month.
The triangular competition in Sharjah, in the United Arab Emirates, also involves New Zealand and Sri Lanka. It begins on November 6.

Fast bowler Waqar Younis, rested for the three one-day internationals against Zimbabwe, also returns but the selectors again ignored experienced fast bowler Aaqib Javed, who has a fine record in Sharjah.
Also missing is experienced batsman Inzamamul Haq, who has been told to improve his fitness following recent knee surgery.

Paceman Abdul Razzak, who made his international debut against Zimbabwe in the second one-day game on Friday, and middle-order batsmen Azam Khan and Hasan Raza will make their first trips abroad for the national team.
Wasim Akram (captain), Saeed Anwar, Aamir Sohail, Salim Malik, Ijaz Ahmad, Hasan Raza, Azam Khan, Moin Khan, Saqlain Mushtaq, Shahid Afridi, Mushtaq Ahmad, Waqar Younis, Shahid Nazir, Abdul Razzak.
